data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Shelba means 'little shepherdess'. This name is derived from the Hebrew word 'shalab', which means 'to ascend'. In the Bible, God is described as a shepherd who guides and protects his flock. Thus, the name Shelba symbolizes the gift of God's protection and care. The name Shelba carries the meaning “God's gift, little shepherdess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Shelba usually hope their child will grow to embody god's gift, little shepherdess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Shelba highlights the importance of God's care and attention towards his flock.
